profiles.name: CalcPad
profiles.description: Turn your device into a numpad and use touch buttons to enter numbers instead of mouse and keyboard. Press the calculator symbol to launch your calculator. It works with GNOME, KDE, Xfce, Cinnamon and minimal. For Wayland and X11.
profiles.author: Rand0mB0y
commands: sh -c 'for c in gnome-calculator kcalc xfce4-calculator xcalc; do if command -v $c >/dev/null; then case $c in gnome-calculator) t=gnome-calculato; w=Calculator;; xfce4-calculator) t=xfce4-calculato; w=Calculator;; kcalc) t=kcalc; w=KCalc;; *) t=$c; w=xcalc;; esac; if pgrep -x $t >/dev/null; then if [ $c = gnome-calculator ]; then busctl --user call org.gnome.Shell /de/lucaswerkmeister/ActivateWindowByTitle de.lucaswerkmeister.ActivateWindowByTitle activateBySubstring s Calculator 2>/dev/null; if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; fi; if command -v wmctrl >/dev/null; then wmctrl -a $w 2>/dev/null; if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; fi; exec $c; else exec $c; fi; fi; done'
